Present:- Mr. Sunny K. Singla, Advocate
 for the petitioners.
Mr. Parneet Singh Pandher, Aag, Punjab.

Mr. Shubham Chandel, Advocate
 for respondent No.2.

Prayer in this petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is for quashing of F.I.R. No.126 dated 12.07.2012 registered under Sections 420, 120-B of the IPC registered at Police Station Moga City,
District Moga and all subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise dated 03.02.2023 (Annexure P-2).

This Court vide order dated 04.05.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the trial Court to get their statements recorded and the learned Magistrate was directed to send its report qua the genuineness of the compromise.
Pursuant to the aforesaid order, parties have appeared before Learned Chief Judicial Magistrate and got their statements recorded.

On the basis of the statements so recorded, Learned Magistrate has submitted report dated 26.05.2023 to the effect that the compromise has been effected 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:107464 2023:PHHC:107464 between the parties voluntarily and Gurmit Singh And Another vs State Of Punjab And Another on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195351213/

sentences.text: Learned State counsel as well as learned counsel for respondent No.2 have not disputed the factum of compromise between the parties.

In view of the above, no useful purpose would be served to continue with the proceedings before the trial Court in the instant F.I.R.
Following the principles laid down by the Full Bench judgment of this Court in Kulwinder Singh and others Versus State of Punjab and another 2007 (3) RCR (Criminal) 1052 and approved by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh Versus State of Punjab and others (2012) 10 SCC 303, this petition is allowed and F.I.R. No.126 dated 12.07.2012 registered under Sections 420, 120-B of the IPC registered at Police Station Moga City, District Moga and all subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise dated 03.02.2023 (Annexure P-2), are quashed qua the petitioners.
